title: Hermit Kingdom Through the Lens of Multiple Perspectives: A Case Study of LLM Hallucination on North Korea

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the accuracy, consistency, and refusal-to-answer (RtA) rates of LLM outputs across identical prompts presented in three different languages (English, Mandarin Chinese, and Korean) to identify performance disparities.

Qualitatively evaluating model responses to geopolitical topics, false rumors, and lesser-known facts to determine if the models replicate or perpetuate existing stereotypes and sensationalist falsehoods about North Korea.
